articles.title_en: Trump again says Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire. For Zelensky, it came as ‘news.’
articles.lead_en: U.S. President Donald Trump announced on Sunday that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a ceasefire in the energy sector.
